newsitem.title: BELGIUM: TUNISIA ARRESTS BELGIAN POLITICIAN COOLS ASSASSINS.
newsitem.headline: TUNISIA ARRESTS BELGIAN POLITICIAN COOLS ASSASSINS.

text.p: Tunisian police have arrested two Tunisians suspected of killing leading Belgian politician Andre Cools who was gunned down more than five years ago, the Belgian Foreign Ministry said on Thursday.

"Our ambassador (in Tunis) has received information (from Tunisian Justice Minister Sadok Chaabane) about two Tunisians who have been arrested in connection with the murder of Cools," a ministry spokesman told Reuters.
Cools, a former Socialist minister, was shot at point-blank range in the car park outside his mistress's appartment near the eastern Belgian city of Liege on July 18, 1991.
Belgian media said the two had been questioned in Tunis and confessed to having killed a prominent Belgian politician after being contracted by a man of European nationality.

The ministry said Tunisia normally did not extradite its nationals, which would make it unlikely the two will stand trial in Belgium. But the spokesman said that Belgium and Tunisia planned to coordinate investors.
Six people, including former government minister Alain Van der Biest, have been arrested and charged with orchestrating Cools's murder. Van der Biest denies any involvement in the killing.
